```{r}
cosine_matrix = function(raw_data){
    # rel*rel matrix caculated by cosine similarity
    n <- nrow(raw_data)  # raw_data is an n x n matrix, 123*dimensions
    # create an empty matrix to store cosine similarity
    raw_data_cor <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)
    colnames(raw_data_cor) <- rownames(raw_data)
    rownames(raw_data_cor) <- rownames(raw_data)
    # calculate the cosine similarity of the upper triangular part
    for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):n) {
            cosine_value <- cosine(as.numeric(raw_data[i, ]), as.numeric(raw_data[j, ]))
            raw_data_cor[i, j] <- cosine_value
        }
    }
    # symmetrically fill the cosine similarity in the lower triangular part
    raw_data_cor <- raw_data_cor + t(raw_data_cor)

    # set the diagonal to 1
    diag(raw_data_cor) <- 1
    return(raw_data_cor)
}

lowerTriangle <- function(m){
  return(m[lower.tri(m,diag = FALSE)])
}

# R.scale() uses ddof=1, but sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler() uses ddof=0
scaleN <- function(data){
  data_scaled <- scale(data)*sqrt(nrow(data)/(nrow(data)-1))  
  return(data_scaled)
}
```

```{r}
prompt_rels_map = read.xlsx('../1_DeepSeek_Description/modern/relationships.xlsx')
name_mapping <- setNames(prompt_rels_map$'relations', # new name
                         prompt_rels_map$'query') # old name
print(name_mapping)
```


```{r}
rel_emb_sim_modern = function(input_path,output){
    files = list.files(input_path)
    for (file in files){
        file_path = paste0(input_path,file)
        bert_data = read.csv(file_path,row.names=1,fileEncoding = "gb18030")

        # change the suitable labels
        bert_data$'word' = name_mapping[bert_data$'word']
        rownames(bert_data) = bert_data$'word'
        bert_data = bert_data[,-1]
        bert_data = bert_data[rels_order_modern,]
        
        #bert_data$'word' = name_mapping[rownames(bert_data)]
        #new_names = name_mapping[rownames(bert_data)]
        #rownames(bert_data) = new_names
        #bert_data = bert_data[, sapply(bert_data, is.numeric)]
        #bert_data = bert_data[rels_order_modern, ]

        # scale by column(1024d)
        bert_data_scaled = scaleN(bert_data)
        # caculate cosine_similarity
        bert_data_cor = cosine_matrix(bert_data_scaled)
        
        sum(is.na(bert_data))    # 统计每列缺失

        output_path = paste0(output,file)
        dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
        write.csv(bert_data_cor,output_path)
    }
    print(input_path)
}
```


```{r}
library(readxl)

prompt_rels_map = read.xlsx('../1_DeepSeek_Description/modern/relationships.xlsx')

prompt_rels_map$query<-trimws(as.character(prompt_rels_map$query))
prompt_rels_map$relations <- trimws(as.character(prompt_rels_map$relations))

# 创建映射字典：Query文本 -> 关系名称
# 比如："夫妻之间" -> "夫妻"
name_mapping <- setNames(prompt_rels_map$relations, prompt_rels_map$query)

# 【关键步骤 B】确立 142 对关系的完整顺序列表
# 这里的 unique 确保了如果有重复行也不会报错，这是我们要输出的最终行名列表
target_142_order <- unique(prompt_rels_map$relations)

print(paste("目标关系总数：", length(target_142_order))) # 应该显示 142
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 2. 函数定义：处理 BERT 数据
# ==========================================
rel_emb_sim_modern = function(input_path, output){
  files = list.files(input_path)
  
  for (file in files){
    file_path = paste0(input_path, file)
    
    # 读取 BERT 数据
    # 注意：如果不确定第一列是不是行名，建议 header=TRUE, 然后手动处理
    bert_data = read.csv(file_path, row.names=1, fileEncoding = "gb18030")
    
    # 检查是否存在 'word' 列
    if(is.null(bert_data$word)) {
      print(paste("跳过文件（无word列）:", file))
      next
    }
    
    # 【关键步骤 C】清洗 BERT 数据里的 Query 文本
    # 强制去空格，确保能和映射表对上
    current_queries <- trimws(as.character(bert_data$word))
    
    # 执行映射：将 Query 文本转为 关系名称
    mapped_names <- name_mapping[current_queries]
    
    # 【排查点】检查是否有映射失败的（即变成了 NA）
    if(any(is.na(mapped_names))) {
      # 打印出前 5 个匹配失败的词，方便你检查原因
      failed_words <- current_queries[is.na(mapped_names)]
      print(paste("【警告】文件", file, "中有", length(failed_words), "个词映射失败！"))
      print("示例失败词汇（请检查Excel里是否有这些词，注意标点和空格）:")
      print(head(failed_words))
      
      # 暂时剔除这些匹配不上的行，防止后面报错
      valid_idx <- !is.na(mapped_names)
      bert_data <- bert_data[valid_idx, ]
      mapped_names <- mapped_names[valid_idx]
    } else {
      # 如果没问题，就赋值新的名字
      bert_data$word <- mapped_names # 此时 word 列已经变成了 "夫妻", "父子" 等
    }
    
    # 将行名修改为关系名称
    # 注意：如果有重复的关系名（比如两个不同的query映射到了同一个关系），这里会报错
    # 我们假设关系是唯一的。如果有重复，需要去重。
    bert_data <- bert_data[!duplicated(bert_data$word), ]
    rownames(bert_data) = bert_data$word
    
    # 移除非数值列 (word列)
    # 假设除了 word 之外都是 embedding 数值
    bert_data_numeric <- bert_data[ , colnames(bert_data) != "word"]
    
    # 【关键步骤 D】按照 142 个关系的顺序重新排列
    # 找出当前数据里有的、且在目标列表里的关系
    common_rels <- intersect(target_142_order, rownames(bert_data_numeric))
    
    # 检查缺失情况
    if(length(common_rels) < 142){
      missing <- setdiff(target_142_order, rownames(bert_data_numeric))
      print(paste("【提示】文件", file, "包含关系数:", length(common_rels), "/ 142"))
      if(length(missing) > 0 && length(missing) < 20) { # 只有少量缺失才打印
         print(paste("缺失:", paste(missing, collapse=",")))
      }
    }
    
    # 重新排序（这一步会自动剔除多余的，保留标准的 142 个）
    # 如果缺失了某个关系，这里会产生 NA 行。我们先只取有的。
    bert_data_final <- bert_data_numeric[common_rels, ]
    
    # 只有当数据不为空时才计算
    if(nrow(bert_data_final) > 1){
      # Scale
      bert_data_scaled = scaleN(bert_data_final)
      # Cosine
      bert_data_cor = cosine_matrix(bert_data_scaled)
      
      # 输出
      output_path = paste0(output, file)
      dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      write.csv(bert_data_cor, output_path)
    }
  }
  print(paste("处理完成目录:", input_path))
}

```

```{r}
}
```

## ancient
```{r}
prompt_rels_map = read.csv('human_rating_data/ancient_modern_map_143r.csv',row.names=1,check.names=FALSE, fileEncoding = "gb18030")
name_mapping <- setNames(prompt_rels_map$'对应的现代人际关系', # new name
                         prompt_rels_map$'query') # old name
```

```{r}
rel_emb_sim_ancient = function(input_path,output){
    files = list.files(input_path)
    for (file in files){
        file_path = paste0(input_path,file)
        bert_data = read.csv(file_path,row.names=1,encoding='gb18030')

        # change the suitable labels
        bert_data = bert_data[bert_data$'word' %in% prompt_rels_map$'query',]
        bert_data$'word' = prompt_rels_map$'对应的现代人际关系'
        #rownames(bert_data) = bert_data$'word'
        bert_data = bert_data[,-1]

        # scale by column(768d)
        bert_data_scaled = scaleN(bert_data)
        # caculate cosine_similarity
        bert_data_cor = cosine_matrix(bert_data_scaled)

        output_path = paste0(output,file)
        dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
        write.csv(bert_data_cor,output_path)
    }
    print(input_path)
}
```

```{r}
rel_emb_sim_ancient = function(input_path, output) {
  files = list.files(input_path)
  for (file in files) {
    file_path = paste0(input_path, file)
    
    bert_data = read.csv(file_path, row.names=NULL, encoding='gb18030')
    colnames(bert_data)[1] = "old_word"
    
    bert_data_merged = merge(prompt_rels_map[, c("query", "对应的现代人际关系")], 
                             bert_data, 
                             by.x = "query", 
                             by.y = "old_word")
    
    new_labels = bert_data_merged$"对应的现代人际关系"
    
    numeric_data = bert_data_merged[, 3:ncol(bert_data_merged)]
    
    bert_data_scaled = scaleN(numeric_data)
    bert_data_cor = cosine_matrix(bert_data_scaled)
    
    rownames(bert_data_cor) = new_labels
    colnames(bert_data_cor) = new_labels
    output_path = paste0(output, file)
    dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    write.csv(bert_data_cor, output_path)
  }
  print(input_path)
}
```


```{r}
querys = dir('bert_embedding_data/ancient/')
for (query in querys[1:2]){
    input_path = paste0('bert_embedding_data/ancient/',query,'/')
    files = dir(input_path)
    files = files[grep("^(關_)",files)]
    for (file in files){
        file_pair = gsub('關','系',file)
        output_file = gsub('關','關系',file)
        embedding_results1 = read.csv(paste0(input_path,file), row.names=1)
        embedding_results2 = read.csv(paste0(input_path,file_pair), row.names=1)
        
        embedding_results = embedding_results1
        embedding_results[,1:768] = (embedding_results1[,1:768]+embedding_results2[,1:768])/2
        write.csv(embedding_results,
                  paste0('bert_embedding_data/ancient/',query,'/',output_file))
    }
}
```
